001package org.clafer.ontology;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004
005/**
006 *
007 * @author jimmy
008 */
009public class Path {
010
011    private final Concept[] steps;
012
013    public Path(Concept... steps) {
014        this.steps = steps;
015    }
016
017    public Concept getContext() {
018        return steps[0];
019    }
020
021    public Concept[] getSteps() {
022        return steps;
023    }
024
025    public int length() {
026        return steps.length;
027    }
028
029    protected Path newPath(Concept... steps) {
030        return new Path(steps);
031    }
032
033    public Path prepend(Concept step) {
034        Concept[] newSteps = new Concept[steps.length + 1];
035        newSteps[0] = step;
036        System.arraycopy(steps, 0, newSteps, 1, steps.length);
037        return newPath(newSteps);
038    }
039
040    public Path append(Concept step) {
041        Concept[] newSteps = Arrays.copyOf(steps, steps.length + 1);
042        newSteps[steps.length] = step;
043        return newPath(newSteps);
044    }
045
046    public Path replaceContext(Concept newContext) {
047        Concept[] newSteps = Arrays.copyOf(steps, steps.length);
048        newSteps[0] = newContext;
049        return newPath(steps);
050    }
051
052    public Path dropPrefix(int index) {
053        if (index == 0) {
054            return this;
055        }
056        return newPath(Arrays.copyOfRange(steps, index, steps.length));
057    }
058
059    @Override
060    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
061        if (obj instanceof Path) {
062            Path other = (Path) obj;
063            return Arrays.equals(steps, other.steps);
064        }
065        return false;
066    }
067
068    @Override
069    public int hashCode() {
070        return Arrays.hashCode(steps);
071    }
072
073    @Override
074    public String toString() {
075        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
076        result.append(steps[0]);
077        for (int i = 1; i < steps.length; i++) {
078            result.append('.').append(steps[i]);
079        }
080        return result.toString();
081    }
082}
